note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative. The decision is a placeholder sheet whose section tags are supplied; the review frame encloses ONLY the range supplied in routes.from..routes.to — it shows the supplied scope and implies no rule about what a review may or may not cover. The two questions (● A / ◆ B) have equal weight; 'inside / outside the frame' only describes where the supplied section lies relative to the supplied frame. Nothing is admitted, rejected, decided or found; the calendar marks no date and implies no time limit. Brief fields: decisions, grounds (the two questions and their sections), routes (the frame's range), outcomes (inside / outside captions), actorLabels (actorLabels.a), objectLabels, actionProgress, annotations and finalState are editable.
